budget_derivation: G4 final calibration uses five independent 200-repetition batches after 20 warmups on each required CI execution surface. The frozen ceiling for each guarded path is the greatest measured max_ms across the calibration batch evidence; no synthetic multiplier is added. Regression checks compare later p95 against that measured envelope.

environment_comparability.rule: Hard-field change requires versioned supersession. Rolling hosted image_version is retained as exact provenance and remains performance-tested, but is not alone a comparability break because GitHub assigned two image versions concurrently to the same PR while all hard runtime/platform fields were identical.
